en.quote: 2018 will see the first crewed launch [from Vostochny].
en.head: No crewed launch took place from Vostochny in 2018.
en.body: Vostochny hosted its first uncrewed launch in April 2016. The crewed launch forecast for 2018 did not take place by that deadline. Later plans shifted; a new target date is not evidence that a launch occurred.

osrc.t: Roscosmos, Vostochny first launch and revised crewed-launch plan
